sources.title: Heimerdinger Build Guide: [MASTER TIER 11 MILLION MASTERY HEIMERDINGER 🔧 GUIDE]

passive.name: Hextech Affinity
passive.text: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

spells.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
spells.text: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

spells.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
spells.text: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

spells.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
spells.text: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

spells.name: UPGRADE!!!
spells.text: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

axis.value: Heimerdinger plays aggressively in lane, using early trades and pressure to seek kills before level 6.

winCondition.value: Heimerdinger wins by building an early lead through aggressive play and snowballing it.

spikes.why: Heimerdinger gains an early power spike that can start a snowball.
Heimerdinger thrives on itemization and power spikes, and a small amount of gold can give him a large lead.
Heimerdinger can increase the effects of his next spell.

bait.why: After Heimerdinger uses CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, its stun and slow are unavailable during its 11-second cooldown.
After Heimerdinger fires Hextech Micro-Rockets, he cannot fire them again until their cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Heimerdinger should not expect his turrets to deal full damage to towers, because they deal half damage to towers.
